pr.title: fix(github): authenticate Issue reads and return one structured continuation
pr.body:
Canonical Issue reads previously depended on the unauthenticated IP quota. `soodles github issue NUMBER` now shares an authenticated reader with automatic, supervised and worker admission. The supervisor supplies a repository-scoped installation token; the reader refuses missing credentials and redirects, revalidates cached bytes through authenticated 304, and returns provider-derived quota waits with exit 75 without retry or anonymous fallback.

Eleven fixed external defect/cure/non-case triplets and 16 reader / 16 consumer tests pass. Live App evidence confirms ed3c/soodles with Issues:read and implicit Metadata:read, actual 200 → 304 reads, unchanged remaining primary quota for the cached read, and token revocation. [Exact-head Linux canonical acceptance](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35189253585) passed; the earlier macOS/Linux mismatch remains recorded.

The genuine `soodles-44` order is performing fresh CLI and refusal verification in its Noodle-owned worktree. The prior rejected #39 proposal was safely retired by independently delivered Noodle #84; #39 comparison remains paused. This PR uses the same candidate as preparation PR #45, on the branch bound to the real order as required by the existing landing owner. Stage completion, provider delivery and local reconciliation remain separate; this feature does not establish global anonymous-network blocking or reduced Agent decision cost.

Refs ed3c/soodles#44

issue.title: Authenticated Issue reader: minimum GitHub App use and one Session entry
issue.body:
Canonical Issue reads must stop depending on unauthenticated public API quota. Session supplies intent; the existing supervisor supplies one repository-scoped GitHub App installation token. The reader only consumes it.

N: this specification and metrics. P: shortest Session route and missing-input owner. L: authenticated read/conditional-cache/quota gates consumed by real admission before effects. R: exact GitHub response and provider-enforced token scope; neither local GREEN nor capability success closes the Issue.

The installation was read back as App 4753873, installation 157336758, with access to ed3c/soodles. Live proof must request only repositories=[soodles], permissions={issues:read}, plus implicit metadata. Credentials and private keys never enter evidence.

## Implementation and scoped readback — 2026-09-17

Implemented in draft [PR #45](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/pull/45), candidate `0cda9c2ee57ed598257048f50829fb36893d3b80`.

- N: [immutable receipt and referenced raw evidence](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/0cda9c2ee57ed598257048f50829fb36893d3b80/docs/evidence/github-read/receipt.json) records scope and measurements; no absolute minimum-cost or Agent decision-cost claim.
- P: `./soodles github issue NUMBER` is the Session entry. The existing supervisor supplies a repository-scoped installation token in the actual child's `GH_TOKEN`; the recipe names the existing supplier and exact repository/permission restrictions. Missing input and quota wait identify their owner and existing continuation.
- L: automatic/supervised/worker share the authenticated reader. Eleven frozen external defect RED → corrected same control GREEN → legal non-case GREEN triplets pass, as do 16 reader and 16 consumer tests. No credential means no request; no anonymous fallback, redirect forwarding, stale success or automatic retry. Quota wait returns 75 and preserves the existing mailbox/worker boundary.
- R: App 4753873 / installation 157336758 minted only `ed3c/soodles`, `issues:read` and implicit `metadata:read`. Final source CLI observations are HTTP 200 → 304 with remaining 6198 → 6198. Token revocation returned 204. [Exact-head Linux canonical acceptance](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35189253585), attempt 1, job 105097957080, passed; quality-report also passed.

The real automatic consumer read live #44 through the default authenticated reader, but its Noodle state was explicitly a local owner fixture. This is not a live Noodle worker/typed-outcome or full delivery claim. The earlier token-alphabet defect and macOS/Linux-test mismatch remain preserved rather than relabeled as successes.

**Still OPEN / delivery pending:** the production Noodle root contains no original `soodles-44` order and retains the paused pending proposal at revision `dfb96fcf7d8d776ea177173c4c0c717d`. The existing landing owner requires the completed original order and quiescent sessions before terminal reconciliation. No merge/closure was offered; no production state reset, replacement scheduler or #39 retry occurred. The code and physical reader proof do not remove that distinct lifecycle requirement. This body update also requires a fresh supervisor envelope before future admission; prior live receipts retain their original body identity.


## Fresh supervised continuation — 2026-09-17
Noodle #84 is provider-delivered and its original order reconciled. Its explicitly selected native binary safely retired the rejected #39 proposal through exact owner next; canonical checkpoint and orders projection bytes were unchanged, no #39 comparison restarted. The old delivery-pending paragraph is historical evidence, not the current proposal state.

Before further delivery, establish the genuine `soodles-44` order to perform fresh authenticated CLI 200/304 and refusal drives, exact candidate review and Agent-produced typed outcome. This is substantive verification/delivery continuation of the already disclosed implementation, not a claim that an order predated earlier code. Do not create an empty completed order. The fixed external controls remain selected outside this candidate; the supervisor pins the already tested reader for this bootstrap and provides only the scoped read token. Exact file paths above replace ambiguous directory labels without expanding the correction.
